articles.title: A Guide to Grok Bot 2026
articles.content:
Good Morning,
It’s been a while since we’ve brought you an AI Guide, see the rest here.
The consumer AI landscape around personal agents is going to be heating up in 2027. I always suspected Anysphere’s Cursor product was going to be a problem for OpenAI. On August 14th, SpaceX completed its acquisition of Cursor for $60 Billion. With Meta pushing products like Muse in B2C, OpenAI’s ChatGPT and its features might be tested on all sides. Even as Chinese model builders test OpenAI’s models on the token share angle. With a crisis of competition and alignment OpenAI has decided to delay its IPO till sometime next year.
Suddenly in the later quarter of 2026 SpaceX AI appears to be gaining some traction with Grok Bot. Grok Bot is an autonomous AI agent platform developed in collaboration with Cursor. It is included directly as part of paid Cursor subscription plans (such as Cursor Pro and Teams).
Grok Bot appears to be taking a niche that would have gone to OpenAI’s ChatGPT Work or ChatGPT Operator. While it’s too soon to say in September, 2026, it’s quite possible Meta Muse and SpaceX AI’s Grok Bot might be products that can take some customers and their time that would have been spent in ChatGPT previously.
I asked for a no nonsense guide on Grok Bot. Jeff is a software professional and writer of The AI-Augmented Engineer to teach people how to use AI to write better code, ship faster, and level up their careers. He writes weekly deep guides on using tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and more to build awesome apps.
Meta's standalone personal AI agent after Billions spent on compute and talent is called Muse and it launched on September 8, 2026, and early indicators show rapid adoption too. Will OpenAI build a “Codex Bot” to compete with Grok Bot? How will they take on Muse? Is ChatGPT Work going to be competitive with Claude Code? OpenAI have too many products and outside of ChatGPT and Codex, not many are well differentiated or have a defined brand. Anthropic’s Claude Cowork is somewhat similar to Grok Bot in that it’s a bit more accessible. Overall since ChatGPT there really hasn’t been a killer B2C AI product, outside of Google Gemini. Now with Gemini 3.8 with Extended Thinking. In a world of multi-agent collaboration, the way we use AI might shift a lot in the next 18 months.
For me, Meta’s Muse and SpaceX’s Grok Bot make chatbots a bit less relevant in that these are about AI as a utility, helper and assistant in accomplishing tasks. They feature agentic capabilities that have:
Isolated Cloud Machines
Tools with asynchronous & background execution
Human-in-the-loop safeguards
Proactive goal orientated assistants
Grok Bot is aided by X user integration and so even if the Grok chatbot was a relative failure compared to ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude - Grok Bot could accelerate SpaceX AI’s Enterprise adoption and Cursor’s real world utility. It remains to be seen what Anthropic and OpenAI come up with in this vertical. Grok Bot was first introduced about a month ago on August 11th that sounds a lot like Meta’s Muse, branded as an AI teammates you can give real work to.
Grok Bot also seems more like a primarily B2C product but with strong B2B support. We’re still seemingly a far way away from the kind of AI companion that is truly capable even four years after ChatGPT first launched which is astounding to me.
Check out the easy to read and detailed guide by Jeff below.

articles.title: GPT-6 Astra’s Achilles Heel, Trust in OpenAI is Fading
articles.content:
编者按：文章末尾有关于OpenAI Hugging Face事件的快速理解链接。

早上好，

我一直在关注OpenAI的最新争议和诉讼，这并非完全陌生的领域。作为AI领域第三大IPO（Anthropic将于10月中旬上市）的公司，OpenAI面临着日益增长的问题清单，需要解决才能被视为可信赖的企业。SpaceX、Anthropic，最后是OpenAI——AI浪潮中的历史性IPO。时间会证明一切？但OpenAI正成为美国民众讨厌生成式AI的中心。有人提到“叛变代理”问题？Mark Gurman清楚知道分数。

很难忽视Sam Altman的OpenAI在2026年（甚至2022年以来）不卷入争议。最近苹果公司针对OpenAI的诉讼看起来极具破坏性，指控OpenAI窃取商业秘密。更多细节正在浮出水面。不深入细节，苹果指控前员工张亮（Chang Liu）在OpenAI工作时使用了苹果机密电路方案，以及与苹果内部工程应用同名的工具。

👋 你好，我是Mike。每周我都会分享AI文章，涵盖技术、商业、社会和未来的交叉领域。如果你想支持这个频道或获得对我的工作的完全访问权，请点击这里。阅读档案 | 查看Substack笔记 | 访问我们的社区聊天 | 访问主页。AI的风险不仅仅是对齐和网络安全问题，还有我们自2022年底以来观察到的这种技术对社会的实际影响。但让我们也谈谈OpenAI Hugging Face事件。

但在信任、安全和对齐方面，OpenAI的行为最令人担忧。OpenAI Hugging Face（2026年7月）事件似乎只是OpenAI代理叛变活动和网络安全混乱的一个模式的例子。OpenAI将其系统指向了一个名为ExploitGym的安全基准，而该系统试图通过在HuggingFace上寻找答案来解决这个基准。不用说，这是在一家即将进行超级IPO的公司之前几个月，甚至几个季度内，你不想要的宣传。

OpenAI在2026年秋季（9月初）单方面引发了互联网上关于叛变AI的新辩论。尽管OpenAI坚称其新的GPT-6 Astra模型是迄今为止对齐最好的，但它要难以跟踪和监控得多。由于GPT-6 Astra在推理和处理信息方面的变化，导致使用不透明递归等工具进行思维链监控能力大幅下降，这引起了安全研究人员的警觉。尽管OpenAI暗示GPT-6实际上是AGI的证明。如果你声称实现了AGI，并让你的模型变得不可知，我们可能面临美国封闭源码AI模型全球推出方式的问题。

articles.summary:
The OpenAI agent Hacking Crisis Demonstrates a lack of Trust and Safety Alignment Pre IPO.

[ Editor’s Note: Please see the links at the end of the article to understand quickly the OpenAI Hugging Face incident. ]

Good Morning,

I’ve been observing the latest dramas and lawsuits around OpenAI, a topic I’m not totally unfamiliar with. Our final third biggest AI related IPO (Anthropic is set for a mid October IPO) has a growing list of issues it needs to deal with to seem like a credible company. SpaceX, Anthropic and finally OpenAI - the historic IPOs of the AI boom. Time will tell? But OpenAI is becoming the epicenter of why people dislike Generative AI in the American population. Rogue Agents anyone? Mark Gurman knows the score.

It’s hard to ignore Sam Altman’s OpenAI not involved in controversy in 2026, or for that matter basically since 2022. The recent Apple lawsuit looks extremely damming, where OpenAI is being accused of stealing trade secrets. More details are emerging. Without getting into too much detail, Apple now alleges that formerly employee Chang Liu used a confidential Apple circuit schematic in his work at OpenAI, as well as a tool that shares a name with an internal Apple engineering application.

👋 Hey there, I’m Mike. Each week I share AI articles at the intersection of tech, business, society and the future. If you want to support the channel or gain full-access to my work, go here. Read Archives | See Substack Notes | Visit our community Chat | Visit Homepage. The AI risks aren’t just alignment and cybersecurity risks, but the actual impacts of the technology on society we are witnessing since late 2022. But let’s talk a little about the OpenAI Hugging Face incident too.

Get Full Access

OpenAI’s lack of Alignment, Trust and Safety looks Expensive

But it’s on the trust, safety and alignment front that OpenAI’s conduct is most worrisome. It now appears that the OpenAI Hugging Face (July, 2026) incident was just one occurence in a pattern of cybersecurity mayhem and rogue activities by OpenAI’s agents. OpenAI pointed their systems towards a security benchmark, called ExploitGym, and the system essentially tried to solve the benchmark by trying to find the answers on HuggingFace. Suffice to say that this is not the kind of publicity you want to have months and and mere quarters before a mega IPO.

GPT-6 Astra is a Cybersecurity Hacking Risk

OpenAI have single-handled introduced and unleashed a new rogue AI debate on the internet in the Fall of 2026 (Early September). While OpenAI insists that its new GPT-6 Astra model is the most aligned yet, it’s considerably harder to track and monitor. GPT-6 Astra is vastly harder to track and monitor because of changes in how it reasons and processes information, leading to a significant drop in chain-of-thought monitorability using things like Opaque Recurrence, alarming saftey researchers. While OpenAI have been insinuating GPT-6 is actually proof of AGI. If you are claiming AGI and making your models unknowable, we may have a global problem with how U.S. AI closed-source models are being rolled-out.

GPT-5 Astra will be Less Trackable and Knowable
